title: ctenopteris rufidula
intro: Ctenopteris rufidula, commonly known as the Fern, is a type of flowering plant. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ctenopteris rufidula include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect the body from oxidative stress.
